Great discovery!
I stumbled upon Moonlight Natural Pet Store while researching for a particular natural supplement for my dog. What a great store! They carry a huge selection of Canadian pet products, which is very important for me The brands they carry are high quality and the products are well displayed and well described!
My order came after 2 days (I live in Canmore, Alberta) via Canada Post. The prices are very reasonable and there are no hidden costs. Registration was a breeze. The web site is very user friendly. My whole experience from searching the product to putting my order was super easy.
I’ll be ordering again from Moonlight natural Pet store soon.  Their point incentive seems to be quite good also. Great experience overall!
All kinds of good quality products. And I got some great advice relating to my new rescue dog. I highly recommend Moonlight!
Friendly staff and unique products for all ages of pets

I have 2 small dogs and they are always delighted to shop at this store. The staff are consistantly personable and genuinely care about animal wellbeing and they routinely help trouble shoot issues with excellent recommendations.

Excellent service. Decent prices. Fast delivery. Thank you!
Ordering was very easy, love that this is a Canadian company, and my order was delivered quickly. Was very impressed.

Our go-to shop for food, treats, and gear for our dog. Parking is super easy, and free local delivery is a boon for busy weeks when we can't stop by in-person. The staff are always friendly and helpful.
Moonlight provides "old fashioned" great service (still can't believe the staff remember my name and my cats name)!  Plus the delivery option!  You're the best.

I’ve been here a few times and had some nice, quiet, friendly service — but life threw me a bit of curveball and my efforts to make it out to buy cat food have been falling short.

I decided to give Moonlight’s delivery a shot. I live within the Hastings Crossing neighbourhood, and my delivery was beyond excellent.

The driver was patient and kind, beyond so given how I missed the initial buzz. I was called and kindly asked to retry buzzing, which I was happy to do.

The driver brought the parcel to the door which was another thing I majorly appreciated — I was feeling very sick, so avoiding the extra stress was majorly appreciated!

Everything was carefully packed, fairly priced, and they included some dried sardines for my little girl that she went bonkers for!

Thanks Moonlight, and readers, stop ordering your stuff from Amazon and shop local! It’s always worth it :)

Love that I can call and order heavy things that I need for my feisty cat and it was all delivered with clear, supportive communication!  So helpful!! Thank you to all the wonderful staff at Moonlight!
Bright and clean atmosphere and incredibly kind staff who clearly love dogs!

I was impressed by the level of attentive & kind service in this store. It is a bit out of my way, but I'll happily make a detour to shop there. Good service makes all the difference! They have a good selection of quality products, and the store is beautiful too. Highly recommended!

The sweetest local pet store!!

They were able to offer next day delivery to East Van when I needed some green lipped mussel powder ASAP and they reached out immediately when they noticed I forgot to include my unit number.

I was so impressed that the delivery driver actually got a hold of me because the buzzer wasn’t working and he didn’t want to leave my package in the lobby. Honestly the best customer service.

Thank you Moonlight!
Staff are top notch and sooooo kind! Best service I’ve had at a pet store time after time. Will never shop elsewhere :)

I did forget to tell my husband what the store was called so he was confused when they only stated their store name at the door.  Oopsie, sorry guys! I'm very happy with the quick delivery of the CBD Oil I ordered online. It was very well packaged obviously to protect the glass bottle during shipping.
My guy Jonnie is 4 years old and he was extremely healthy until he started having seizures about 6 weeks ago. We are still working with our vet to determine what is causing these episodes.
I'm hoping this CBD oil will help lessen the possibility of him having more seizures.
Thank you so much to Moonlight Natural Pet AND  Creating Brighter Days, for their diligence and attention to producing these clean safe products! (No shortcuts).
Directions to administer the CBD oil are simple and easy to follow. My dog is not a large dog, but figuring out the dosage by weight was easy.
I will update my review as I continue to monitor Jonnie and see exactly how well he does with this product.
I hope and pray my little guy has a very long and healthy life.
Warmest Regards,
Steve Berentes.

I visited Moonlight Natural Pet Store last week after reading all the amazing reviews, hoping to buy CBD oil for my puppy’s anxiety. Unfortunately, the product I wanted was sold out, but when I mentioned that I had traveled a long distance to get there, the store manager kindly offered me a sample to try first. That thoughtful gesture really stood out!

The staff were incredibly polite, knowledgeable, and patient they answered all my questions and gave me great recommendations. Overall, I had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend this shop and their amazing team to any pet owner.
Love this place! So many good products and a helpful staff!
